lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As Luke enters the lobby, he finally sees the receptionist.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Well, well, well. Leaving so soon?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Yes, thank you for your hospitality—

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Official? I AM the official! From the mall! You really are gullible, aren't you?

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: And you fell for it! Now, about that unpaid room charge...

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I need to get out of here!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke manages to escape, but in his panic, he climbs onto a delivery truck.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'll just ride this until I'm safe...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the truck hits a bump, and Luke falls off.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Ow... where... where am I now?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke looks around. Nothing but mist and emptiness.
